), the holding company for Cathay Bank, announced on Wednesday that it has received a regulatory approval for an increase to its existing share repurchase program by $50 million.
The share repurchase program that authorizes the company to buy back an aggregate of $200 million of its common stock will expire on April 23, 2027, the same expiration date as the original program.

The company has so far repurchased 1,407,189 shares of its common stock at an average cost of $61.86 per share, leaving about $113 million in remaining availability under the share repurchase program after giving effect to the increase.
As of the date of this release, the company has nearly 65,720,263 shares of common stock outstanding.

title: Cathay General Bancorp increases share repurchase limit by $50M
